fields.notes: The DVI Compliance Test Specification (DDWG) and HDMI Compliance Test Specification (HDMI LLC) define the formal verification programmes for DVI/HDMI transmitters; this list captures spec-derived design-time verification categories for TFP410 specifically. HDMI audio data islands, video preamble, HDCP cipher, and CEC are NOT applicable to TFP410.
verification_categories_derived_from_spe: Register access (read/write to all register fields; reserved-bit behavior)
Nominal transfer / transaction across the protocol's operating modes
Error and fault condition detection and handling
